talk.jaymospowers.patrol.relief.offer: "Not every job's a fight. The healers down here are short of limphium, and the dried leaf keeps. Bring %1$s dried leaves to any town's healer and the Patrol pays for the run."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.relief.taken: "Good. Hand them to the healer yourself, they'll want to know who brought them."
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.relief.on_it: "You're already on a run: %1$s dried limphium leaves to a town's healer."
message.jaymospowers.patrol.relief_done: Relief run done: %1$s takes the limphium. Paid %2$s. Relief runs: %3$s.
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.file: "Your file, officer. Rank: %1$s. Arrests on warrant: %2$s. Skip writs drawn: %3$s. Relief runs: %4$s."
